bio.text: Jonathan Jackson represents Illinois's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House and serves on the Agriculture and Foreign Affairs committees.
He is the son of civil rights leaders Rev. Jesse Jackson and Jacqueline Jackson and, according to his office, has served as national spokesman for the Rainbow PUSH Coalition.
He holds a bachelor's degree in business from North Carolina Agricultural & Technical State University and an MBA from Northwestern University's Kellogg School of Management.
